Redraw from the attached valley plate in exactly the same hand-colored engraving style, palette and paper. Redraw from the attached valley plate in exactly the same hand-colored engraving style, palette and paper. A close view of the upper part of the same slender stone tower filling the image: the conical tiled roof at the top, ivy on the stone, and the large arched window in the center. Inside the window, seen from outside, the old wizard in a blue robe and pointed hat sits at a wooden desk in side view writing on parchment with a feather quill, a lit candle beside him, bookshelves and an armillary sphere behind. Sky and paper around the tower

Redraw from the attached valley plate in exactly the same hand-colored engraving style, palette and paper. NO frog, NO lily pads, NO flowers on the water and no animals: the water surface is empty

Redraw from the attached valley plate in exactly the same hand-colored engraving style, palette and paper. NO butterflies and no animals
